title: Codex, Grok Build and OpenCode CLIs are installed on this development machine
body: Run harness checks directly: codex-cli 0.163, grok 1.0.41 and OpenCode 1.19.3 are installed (2026-10-22; OpenCode was upgraded from 1.16.2 for its free models). Codex answers `codex exec -s workspace-write "..." < /dev/null` (without the redirect it waits on stdin); its hooks run only after the owner trusts the project and approves them in /hooks. Grok is not signed in and has no credits, so `grok -p` fails; `grok inspect` still lists a plugin's hooks and skills. Useful: `grok plugin validate <path>` (passes manifests Grok then ignores, so confirm with inspect), `opencode debug startup` and `opencode debug skill`.
not_derivable: The installed versions, the sign-in state and the owner-only trust step are facts of this machine on 2026-10-22, not of the repository.

evidence.summary: The installer used in the live checks.
